import nanosurf
import time
import os

# Load application
spm = nanosurf.SPM()
application = spm.application

# Get access to different components
scan = application.Scan
opmode = application.OperatingMode
zcontrol = application.ZController
head = application.ScanHead

# Set Z controller parameters (PID gains)
print("Setting PID gains...")
zcontrol.PGain = 100
zcontrol.IGain = 6000
zcontrol.DGain = 10

# Set scan parameters for 10x10 µm² area
print("Configuring scan parameters...")
scan.ImageWidth = 10e-6  # 10 µm in meters
scan.ImageHeight = 10e-6  # 10 µm in meters
scan.Scantime = 0.1  # 0.1 seconds per line
scan.Lines = 32  # 32 lines per frame

print("Configuration complete!")
print(f"Image Width: {scan.ImageWidth} m")
print(f"Image Height: {scan.ImageHeight} m")
print(f"Time per line: {scan.Scantime} s")
print(f"Lines per frame: {scan.Lines}")
print(f"PID Gains - P: {zcontrol.PGain}, I: {zcontrol.IGain}, D: {zcontrol.DGain}")

# Perform 3 sequential scans
for scan_num in range(1, 4):
    print(f"\n=== Starting Scan {scan_num} ===")
    
    # Start scan
    scan.StartFrameUp()
    
    # Wait for scan to complete
    scanning = scan.IsScanning
    while scanning:
        remaining_lines = scan.Lines - scan.Currentline
        print(f"Scan {scan_num} in progress... Remaining lines: {remaining_lines}")
        time.sleep(2)
        scanning = scan.IsScanning
    
    print(f"Scan {scan_num} finished!")
    time.sleep(1)  # Brief pause between scans

print("\nAll 3 scans completed successfully!")
del spm
